# The clang-tidy findings on the new core that the static analysis gate accepts (ADR-0040 item 3,
# .github/scripts/static-findings.py), one "<file>|<check>|<message>" per line, once for each line of
# the file that has it. A finding that is not here fails the static-analysis job of windows.yml.
#
# The findings of src/Core when the gate started (2026-10-22, the first run of the job):
# - CryptoCert.c: &data, a BYTE **, passed as the void * of CryptEncodeObjectEx with
#   CRYPT_ENCODE_ALLOC_FLAG, as the API documents it
# - Noise.c: the switch of NoiseSuiteName, which returns NULL after it for every other suite
# - NoiseSession.c: the switch of NoiseLoginParse over the login method, which the parse refused
#   before it for a value above NOISE_LOGIN_JOIN
# - Peer.c: PeerOpenSignal drops a malformed envelope and a malformed signal with the same reason,
#   at two different steps
# - TransportQuic.c: the credential flags of the client (CLIENT, NO_CERTIFICATE_VALIDATION and
#   INDICATE_CERTIFICATE_RECEIVED, 21 together) are bit flags of msquic, which its QUIC_CREDENTIAL_FLAGS
#   enum does not list as one value; msquic's own samples combine them the same way (CORE-S1-1)
src/Core/CryptoCert.c|bugprone-multi-level-implicit-pointer-conversion|multilevel pointer conversion from 'BYTE **' (aka 'unsigned char **') to 'void *', please use explicit cast
src/Core/Noise.c|bugprone-switch-missing-default-case|switching on non-enum value without default case may not cover all cases
src/Core/NoiseSession.c|bugprone-switch-missing-default-case|switching on non-enum value without default case may not cover all cases
src/Core/Peer.c|bugprone-branch-clone|repeated branch body in conditional chain
src/Core/TransportQuic.c|clang-analyzer-optin.core.EnumCastOutOfRange|The value '21' provided to the cast expression is not in the valid range of values for 'QUIC_CREDENTIAL_FLAGS'
